verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe Scheduled Tasks with cron schedules that start and run agents autonomously in the background, plus related features like scheduled messages while away and worktree-based isolated background operation. No independent/hands-on corroboration of scheduled automations specifically, and some community reports note reliability/bug issues with the product generally. Missing for 10: independent verification that scheduled/background automations work reliably in practice, more detail on monitoring/failure handling of background runs.
